featured_reviews.review_text:
This was one of the worst food experiences I’ve ever had. We were sold stale ladoos at Trupti and Food, and unfortunately my child ate them before we realised they were old. The taste and smell clearly indicated the sweets were not fresh, yet they were still being sold to customers.

What’s even more alarming is that this doesn’t seem like an isolated issue. Most of the food here appears stale, with shelf life seemingly artificially extended just to push sales, without any concern for customer health or safety—especially that of children.

To make matters worse, the manager at the counter was extremely rude and dismissive when this was pointed out. Instead of taking responsibility or apologising, there was arrogance and complete lack of professionalism.

Absolutely do not recommend. Avoid at all costs.

featured_reviews.review_text:

To my horror, while eating one of the pieces, I found a metallic object embedded inside the sweet (attached image for proof). This is absolutely unacceptable and poses a serious health hazard.

Not only is this a complete failure of basic hygiene and food safety standards, but it's also incredibly dangerous. What if a child or elderly person had bitten into it?

At these prices, one expects quality and trust. Instead, this incident has completely eroded my confidence in this brand. I urge everyone to be extremely cautious when buying from this place, and I request the authorities to look into their food preparation practices.

Trupti, this is not just about a bad experience – it’s about customer safety. Please take responsibility and fix this.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited this place yesterday in the evening, was craving for choley bhature. It's located near evershine mall, Malad West.
The seating area is small and comfortable.

I ordered for Chholay bhature and kulcha which comes in whole wheat and maida. They serve three types of kulcha along with chholay. The taste was really authentic, i totally loved the way it was served Along with onion, pickle and green chutney.

Then I tried their Rajma chawal which was another fantastic dish, a complete comfort food, feels like homemade. The quality was amazing.

And finally the Chaas and Kesar Rabdi kheer which was so satisfying after this delicious meal.

Service was really good and the Staff Mr. Manish hosted us really good.
Must try out this place if you are around Evershine mall.

featured_reviews.name: Virendra Kumawat
featured_reviews.review_text:

I tried, Kulche and chholay it was really good and delicious in taste. It had achar, onions and chutney in it served along with butter milk. The speciality is this place serve in leaf plate which i really loved.

The rajma chawal and jeera was also amazing. 😍😍

The Kesar rabdi kheer was really good. The taste and the quality was on point. The perfect indian dessert.

The service was amazing and taste was on point.
Really worth visiting this place.
